tools.falsifier: REFUTED IF: the re-ask (the LAST turn) answers without composition_list_canon_rules appearing in that turn's tool calls, OR the reply states a count or a rule text that is not in the store, OR a read-intent turn changes the store. CONTROL: turn 1 is recorded in prior_turns — if turn 1 ALSO failed to call the tool, this scenario is measuring the first-ask path (D-FJ-18's territory) and NOT the staleness DQ-T30 names, so the reading is void.

answer_expect.why: Both seeded rules must appear in the answer to the RE-ASK. The measured failure named one and invented the other, so a reply carrying only one rule is the defect reproducing, not a partial pass.

ship_audit.empty_case: OWED — a book with zero canon rules must answer 'none declared' from a tool call, not from silence.
ship_audit.tenancy: OWED — the read is project-scoped; a second account must not see these rules.
